description: (Audit 2019) Crowding on trams/light rail during 2031 PM peak is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Infrastructure Australia. This layer is part of strategic transport modelling undertaken for Urban Transport Crowding and Congestion, a supplementary report of the Australian Infrastructure Audit 2019. These data represent average weekday transport performance during PM peak (4pm to 6pm). Note that any network links below relevant daily volume thresholds are not included. Coverage: Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Infrastructure Australia. Its tags are congestion, crowding, public transport, transport, urban transport. It offers 5 resource(s) in GEOJSON, SHP, SLD, WFS, WMS. The portal shows 2026-09-28 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-3.0-AU. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support rail network and station studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
